purpose: What the public changelog, feature list and open work pages at /changelog, /features and /todo leave out, named by exact identity and never by matching words. tools/build_public_status_pages.py reads this file; the service never does.
rule: A roadmap step, a line of a release record or a line of CHANGELOG.md is left off the public pages when it describes a security or privacy weakness that is not fixed yet, a way to abuse the service, a staff-only route, or a private matter of the owner. Each entry names one roadmap step, one exact line of one release, or one exact line of one CHANGELOG.md section, and gives its reason in one line. A part of the capabilities record is left off the feature list when it names the search backend, which no page names (roadmap S-6.39 and S-6.184), or when its value in the code contradicts how the live service works; each entry names one part by its path in the record. An entry that names nothing the records hold is refused, so the list cannot go stale unseen.
review: This list is reviewed by a person or by an independent verifier. The session that drafts an entry never approves it, and a change to the list is reviewed before the pages it feeds are released. Each review is recorded in reviews with the reviewer, the date and the entries it covered.

reviews.reviewer: The integrating Claude Code session of September 26, 2026 (Claude Opus 5.5), which did not draft the list. It read every entry against its roadmap step, release line or record path, and read the titles of all 227 open steps for an unfixed weakness, an abuse path, a staff route or a private matter of the owner that the list misses; it found none to add. Titles that name the owner's own published tools and papers are public work the owner asked to showcase.
